_note: Page title 'USCIS | Eligibility Category'. TWO cascading controls, not three as on the I-485: eligibility-choice (MUI Select, role=combobox, 7 categories + a 'Select one' placeholder) -> <category>-subcategories radio list, revealed in-page. The radio group name is built from the eligibility-choice value, so here it is 'ADVANCE_PAROLE-subcategories'. There is NO eligibility-category-choice middle control and NO Six-and-Six radio; no control on this page has a non-empty default. next-btn is DISABLED until a subcategory radio is picked (for the 3 categories that have no subcategories it enables as soon as the category is chosen). The subcategory radio list has no <legend> the capture could resolve, so field.question is '' - the question text is the category's subCategoryHeader, captured in question_texts[1] and headings_all[2]. Captured with ADVANCE_PAROLE + PENDING_485 - the IR-1/IR-2/IR-5 advance-parole-on-a-pending-I-485 case. Selection persists immediately without Next (verified by full reload).
